issues.description: Interface name mismatch: the problem statement and template refer to an interface named 'Milkable' with method messageOnMilk(), but the solution repository defines and uses an interface named 'Dairy' (declares messageOnMilk()) and leaves Milkable.java empty. This means code and tests that expect a 'Milkable' interface (and classes implementing it) will not match the solution's 'Dairy' implementations (Seal and Goat implement Dairy). This naming inconsistency will confuse students and can break compilation/tests that look specifically for 'Milkable'.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's Dairy interface to Milkable (move/rename Dairy.java -> Milkable.java, ensure package declaration present) and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement Milkable instead of Dairy. Remove the empty Milkable.java file or replace it with the renamed interface. Alternatively, if intended, update the problem statement and template to refer to 'Dairy' instead of 'Milkable'. Ensure the interface declares String messageOnMilk() and that all references (templates, tests, and solution classes) use the same identifier.
